node.statement: For every nonzero X, approximate associativity and the exact unit give ||W^dagger bold-dot (W bold-dot X)-X||<=epsilon*||W^dagger||*||W||*||X||<4*epsilon*||X||, while submultiplicativity gives ||W^dagger bold-dot (W bold-dot X)||<3*||W bold-dot X||. Hence ||W bold-dot X||>(1-4*epsilon)||X||/3>||X||/4. Thus L_W is injective and, on the finite-dimensional space calX, bijective.
